name: Sakaki Chikage
source:
Appearance: A quiet girl with long, straight dark hair.
With her dark hair and fair skin, her beauty is impressive.
She looks like a typical old-style [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yamato_nadeshiko]Yamato Nadeshiko[/url].
Height: First half of 160 cm.
